documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for For Approval Of The Un-Audited Financial Results (Both Standalone And Consolidated) Of The Company Along With The Limited Review Report For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Manaksia Steels reported record financial performance in FY 2025-26, crossing the H1,000 Crore revenue milestone for the first time. The company successfully transitioned into a value-added coated steel manufacturer by commissioning a new Alu-Zinc coating line and augmenting its existing colour-coated capacity. Management highlighted that this growth was achieved through disciplined capital allocation and a focus on higher-value products, resulting in improved operating leverage and profitability. Looking ahead, the company plans further capacity expansions, including a new colour-coated line and a cold-rolling mill, to sustain its growth trajectory. Manaksia Steels Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the financial year 2024-25, noting a decline in revenue, EBITDA, and profit after tax alongside increased sales tonnage.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested 85 Crore in a new Alu-Zinc Line of 110,800 TPA funded through internal accruals.
capex_expansion.quote: The first expansion programme will comprise the addition of the Company’s new integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 1,10,800 TPA, which would result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year. This investment of H85 Crore was funded through internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: A second expansion programme of 40 Crore will add a new colour coating manufacturing line, enhancing manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line. This will enhance the Company’s manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin weakened to 4.40% in FY 2024-25 from 7.61% in FY 2023-24 due to a decline in revenues and market challenges.
margins_costs.quote: During the last financial year, our EBITDA margin weakened on account of a decline in revenues and market challenges.

risks_headwinds.claim: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector and lower price realizations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector, which has resulted in lower price realizations.

management_commitments.claim: The second expansion programme of a new colour coating manufacturing line is expected to go on stream during the latter part of the current financial year and generate revenues from the last quarter onwards.
management_commitments.quote: This decisive 175% expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of this current financial year, generating revenues for the Company from the last quarter onwards.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
